@graph.name: Paddle Board Tour Houston
@graph.description: Learn to paddleboard on Buffalo Bayou with a 30-minute beginner lesson followed by 90 minutes of guided paddling with views of the Houston skyline. Perfect for first-timers. No experience required.

mainEntity.name: Do I need paddleboarding experience for the tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: No experience needed. The tour starts with a 30-minute lesson covering balance, paddling technique, and how to get back on the board if you fall. After the lesson you spend about 90 minutes on the water paddling with the group.

Most beginners are standing and paddling within the first 15 minutes of the lesson. Buffalo Bayou is calm flatwater with no current or waves, which makes it one of the best places to learn stand-up paddleboarding in Houston.

mainEntity.name: How much does the paddleboard tour cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Paddle Board Tour is $55 per person and runs approximately 2 hours, including the beginner lesson. Tours launch from 1019 Commerce Street in downtown Houston.

mainEntity.name: What should I wear for a paddleboard tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wear a swimsuit or athletic clothes you are comfortable getting wet. Water shoes, flip-flops, or bare feet all work fine on the paddleboard. Bring sunscreen and a change of clothes for after the tour.
